Important Terms and Conditions : SCOPE OF WORK / SCHEDULE OF WORK : WORK FOR installation, commissioning a nd stamping of 100 Tonne capacity Tulla Weighbridge at Durgapur Open Cast Min e Chandrapur Area, WCL. 1. Supply adequate unskilled labour for the alignment of the weighbridge mechanical plat form. Ensuring all safety measures and structural integrity are maintained during instal lation. 2. Install load cell sensors with accurate positioning to ensure proper load distribution and long-term stability. 3. Ensure proper and secure connections of load cell cables to the junction box and indica tor. Verify the full functionality of all load cells, junction box, and indicator system post- installation 4. All load cell cables and signal cables from load cells to the junction box and from the ju nction box to the indicator must be enclosed in GI (Galvanized Iron) flexible conduit pip es to protect against tampering and environmental exposure. No cable should remain e xposed. 5. Signal cable/load cell cables to be metal conduited with GI flexible pipe from load cell t o junction box and junction box to indicator.

6. Provide and install class 1 earthing for the weighbridge platform as per standard electr ical safety norms. Ensure the earth resistance is within the permissible limits defined b y applicable electrical standards. 7. Carry out proper nut-bolting and securing of the mechanical platform to ensure its alig nment, stability, and operational readiness. 8. The bidder shall be responsible for coordinating and ensuring the stamping of the weig hbridge by the inspector of legal metrology, Weights and Measures. All charges related to the stamping and certification process shall be carried out after the successful install ation and commissioning of the weighbridge. However standard challan fee will be borne by WCL. 9. Ensure the installed weighbridge system is fully integrated with the existing infrastruct ure, including electrical, civil and data acquisition systems, if any. Perform full system t esting, calibration, and validation of weighing accuracy. Assist with official stamping an d certification by the competent authority for legal-for-trade use. Note: 1. Work completion period: 30 days from the date of commencement shall be reckoned fr om 10th day of award of work. 2. Inspection, executing & contract controlling authority: Staff Officer(E&T) or his repre sentative 3. Transportation: To and fro transportation cost will be borne by the bidder. 4. While working in mine for handling of works. Bidder should ensure that your workmen shoul d use the safety appliance like Gumboot / Mining shoes / Helmets/ insulated ladder /Hand Gl oves/ safety belt etc. if applicable. 5. Safety of Persons engaged: The contractor shall provide safety equipment to the persons en gaged in carrying out the work. The contractor shall be responsible for any accident. WCL wi ll not accept any liability on that account. All safety rules & regulation shall be observed by t he contractor including following provision of works-man compensation Act / any other Act / Law / rules prevailing as on date. 6. Electricity will be provided by WCL. Guarantee/ Warranty: Bidder should ensure guarantee of the erection/ repair/ supply of material as applicable for work undertaken against all manufacturing defects, design, quality of workmans hip & materials free of cost for a period of 12 months from the date of installation / commissioning . 6.
